name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Fixed cloud storage links (Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive) showing incorrect VIDEO badge and fake stream resolutions. Cloud files now correctly display a CLOUD badge with direct download quality. Fixed YouTube video thumbnail / Photo Cover downloads not fetching the true maximum resolution (maxresdefault) — now always attempts highest quality first with smart fallback.

standard.releaseNotes: Fixed Instagram photo downloads to preserve authentic full aspect ratios (portrait/landscape) without square cropping. Fixed media card and seeker badges to cleanly display PHOTO instead of VIDEO. Fixed single photo posts and direct image extraction across X (Twitter), Facebook, and universal web platforms with maximum original resolution. Restored timeline auto-import and fullscreen panel stability.

releaseNotes: New true Glassmorphism theme engine: Frosted, Clear, and Blur styles ported directly from MediaFetch Pro CEP plugin.
Optimized GPU compositing and zero nested blurs for extended battery life and smooth 60/120fps scrolling.
Short, clean theme selector (Amoled, Frosted, Clear, Blur) with high-contrast text legibility across all UI elements.
